agents.description: Registered agent identities and their permission bindings.

budget.description: Default resource budget for teams and flows.

canary_tokens.description:
User-defined canary tokens for exfiltration detection.
If an AI outputs any of these values, it indicates data exfiltration.

cognitive_core.description: Path to cognitive core directory (personas, heuristics, directives).

credentials.description:
Credential label → backend source mappings.
Only credentials listed here are accessible to agents.

discover.description: Domains to query for AID upstream discovery at startup.

enterprise_auth.description:
Enterprise-managed authorization (MCP extension).
Configures ID-JAG authenticator for corporate IdP integration.

libraries.description: Operator library directories for conf.d-style config composition.

model_ifc.description:
IFC-driven model routing: conversations the safety pipeline
flags as sensitive (PII, secrets) are forced onto a local
model so the data never leaves the device.

model_routing.description:
Within-session model routing for the inference gateway
(`/v1/chat/completions`): downgrade simple turns to a cheaper
model, upgrade on complexity. See navra-model-server's router.

model_server.description:
URL of an external navra model server.
When set, the gateway connects to the model server instead of
loading models in-process. When absent, models are loaded
directly (backward-compatible behavior).

models.description: Named model definitions (embedding, classification, chat, generate).

permissions.description: Named permission sets referenced by agents.

pii_patterns.description:
Custom PII patterns applied globally to all safety pipelines.
Categories defined here are treated as PII for IFC labeling.

registry.description:
Whitelisted MCP servers to advertise in the registry.
These appear in the /v0.1/servers endpoint alongside
navra's own modules and connected upstream servers.

server.description: Server transport, identity, and container settings.

statistical.description: Statistical guardrail configuration for anomaly detection.

temporal_contracts.description: Temporal behavioral contracts for trajectory-level policy enforcement.

triggers.description: Event-driven triggers that start flows automatically.

upstream.description: Upstream MCP servers to proxy through the gateway.

capability_token.description: Enable capability token issuance for this agent.

max_concurrent.description: Maximum concurrent tool calls. Wins over permission set default.

max_context.description: Context window cap. Wins over permission set default.

model.description:
Model override (must match a key in `[models]`). Wins over
permission set default.

name.description: Unique agent identifier used in logging and auth.

permissions.description: Name of the permission set to apply (must match a key in `[permissions]`).

pubkey.description: Path to Ed25519 public key file for capability token auth.

signing_key.description:
Path to an Ed25519 private key for commit signing.
When set, git_commit signs commits with this key using
Git's SSH signing support (gpg.format=ssh).

token_hash.description: BLAKE3 hash of the agent's bearer token.

token_ttl.description: Override token TTL for this agent (seconds).

upstream.description:
Upstream MCP servers visible to this agent (by name). Wins over
permission set default. Empty = inherit from permission set.

AgenticConfig.description:
Operator-defined agentic capabilities for a model.

Configured in `[models.<name>.agentic]` and merged into
the model card at startup.

```toml
[models.granite-code.agentic]
strengths = ["code generation", "fast inference"]
weaknesses = ["limited reasoning", "small context"]
recommended_tasks = ["code review", "simple analysis"]
avoid_tasks = ["multi-step planning"]
tool_use = "basic"
cost_tier = "free"
speed_tier = "fast"
```

avoid_tasks.description: Task types this model should not be used for.

max_agents.description: Maximum concurrent agents this model can serve.

recommended_tasks.description: Task types this model is recommended for.

strengths.description: What this model is good at (free-text tags for routing).

grant_ttl_secs.description:
Time-to-live for cached approval grants in seconds (default: 300 = 5 min).
After approval, the agent has this long to retry the operation.

timeout_secs.description: Timeout in seconds for human approval responses (default: 300).

BudgetConfig.description:
Default resource budget for teams and flows.

Defaults are generous for autonomous operation — agents get
enough iterations, time, and depth to converge on thorough
results. The operator tunes down via config for cost control.

```toml
[budget]
max_agents = 50       # total across all teams/subflows
max_depth = 5         # escalation nesting depth
timeout_secs = 1800   # 30 minutes per flow tree
max_iterations = 200  # per agent ReAct iterations
max_parallel = 4      # concurrent agents (GPU bound)
checkpoint = true     # enable SQLite checkpoint for crash recovery
checkpoint_db = "~/.local/share/navra/checkpoints.db"
```

checkpoint.description: Enable SQLite-backed checkpointing for DAG execution crash resilience.

checkpoint_db.description: Path to the checkpoint SQLite database.

compaction_keep_recent.description: Recent items kept verbatim during conversation compaction.

compaction_trigger_ratio.description: Context fill ratio to trigger conversation compaction.

compression_policy.description:
Enable SelfCompact flow-driven compression policy.
When true, compression fires at flow node boundaries instead of
at a fixed token threshold. Requires flow execution context.

compression_start_ratio.description: Context fill ratio to enable tool output compression. Disabled by default.

head_ratio.description: Ratio of budget allocated to head in head_tail strategy.

max_agents.description: Maximum total agents across all teams/subflows (default: 50).

max_parallel.description:
Maximum tasks running simultaneously (GPU throttling).
0 means no limit.

max_tokens_per_run.description:
Maximum total tokens (input + output) per agent run.
When set, acts as a circuit breaker. Unlimited by default.

max_tool_output_tokens.description: Maximum tool output tokens before truncation (0 = disabled).

timeout_secs.description: Timeout in seconds per flow tree (default: 3600).

is_regex.description: Whether `value` is a regex pattern (default: false = exact match).

value.description: The canary value (exact string or regex pattern).

require_wimse_root.description: Require the chain to originate from a WIMSE-identified agent.

CredentialMapping.description:
A credential source mapping from config.

Maps a label (e.g., "github.pat") to a backend source
(keyring path, environment variable, etc.).

DiscoveryConfig.description:
AID (Agent Identity & Discovery) configuration.

Populates the `/.well-known/agent` JSON endpoint per the AID spec.
See: https://aid.agentcommunity.org/docs/specification

description.description: Human-readable description (max 60 bytes per AID spec).

mdns.description: Enable mDNS/DNS-SD advertising and browsing on the local network.

timeout_secs.description: Timeout in seconds for AID HTTP lookups and mDNS browse (default: 10).

url.description:
Externally-reachable URL of this server's MCP endpoint.
Example: "https://tools.example.com/mcp"

DomainRuleConfig.description: A domain rule entry in config.

domain.description:
Domain name (must be a valid navra Domain: filesystem, git, shell, etc.)
Use "*" as wildcard default for unlisted domains.

operations.description: Allowed operations for this domain. Empty list = deny all.

ExecutionMode.description:
How a model executes: loaded in-process (ONNX) or served via a
runtime backend (llama.cpp, vLLM). Decouples model *purpose*
(embedding, classification, chat) from *how it runs*.

Default: `from_task()` preserves current behavior — embedding and
classification run in-process, chat/generate run served. Operators
can override in config: `execution_mode = "served"` on an embedding
model to serve it via vLLM instead of loading it in-process.

oneOf.description: Load model directly into the navra process (ONNX Runtime).
Spawn a dedicated inference server (llama.cpp, vLLM).

db.description: SQLite database path for the file index.

default_root.description:
Default root path for file_tree when no path argument is given.
Overrides the top-level `cognitive_core` setting for docs routing.

enabled.description: Enable the file module. Default: true.
Enable the git module. Default: true.

GrpcModuleConfig.description: Configuration for a single gRPC module.

command.description:
Command to spawn the module process (first element is binary,
rest are arguments). Empty if the module is externally managed.

max_restarts.description: Maximum number of restarts before giving up (default: 3).

name.description: Module name (used in logging and tool registration).

restart_on_failure.description: Whether to restart the module on failure (default: true).

socket.description: Unix socket path for the module endpoint.

IdentityConfig.description:
Root identity configuration.

Controls where navra stores its Ed25519 root keypair and how
capability tokens are issued.

key_path.description: Path to Ed25519 seed file. If omitted, the OS keyring is used.

nonce_cache_ttl_secs.description: Nonce cache TTL in seconds for replay tracking (default: 7200 = 2 hours).

token_ttl.description: Default capability token TTL in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour).

KvCacheConfig.description:
Asymmetric KV cache configuration.

Keys and values can use different quantization types. TurboQuant
research shows V compression is essentially free (turbo2/turbo3)
while keys need higher precision (q8_0) for attention accuracy.

Presets:
- `SAFE`: q8_0 keys + turbo3 values — 3x savings, zero quality loss
- `BALANCED`: turbo4 keys + turbo3 values — 4x savings, near-zero loss
- `AGGRESSIVE`: turbo3 keys + turbo2 values — 5x savings

KvCacheType.description:
KV cache quantization type.

For llama-server: controls `--cache-type-k` and `--cache-type-v`.
For vLLM: maps to `--kv-cache-dtype` (fp8).
Lower precision reduces VRAM usage at the cost of quality.

TurboQuant variants use PolarQuant (keys) + QJL (values) for
aggressive compression. They require a llama.cpp build with
TurboQuant support (community fork, PR #21089).

library_dirs.description:
Directories to scan for `*.toml` library fragments.
Default: `["~/.config/navra/libraries"]`.

ManifestConfig.description:
Signed tool manifest configuration for an upstream.

Exactly one of `path` or `inline` must be set. The manifest is a
JSON [`navra_auth::manifest::SignedManifest`] — a tool list signed
with the upstream's Ed25519 key. Verification pins the signing key
on first use (TOFU); a later key change rejects the upstream.

```toml
[upstream.manifest]
path = "manifests/github.signed.json"
keystore = "~/.local/share/navra/manifest_keys.json"  # optional
```

path.description: Path to the signed manifest JSON file.

audit_retention_days.description:
Auto-delete audit log entries older than N days.
Default: 365 days (1 year).

auto_distill.description:
Automatically distill facts from session conversations on session end.
Default: true.

pii_filter.description:
PII filter profile for memory ingestion and audit logs.
Uses the same profiles as safety: "standard", "secrets-only", "none".
Default: "standard".

pii_retention_days.description:
Stricter TTL for entries flagged as containing PII.
Default: 30 days.

retention_days.description:
Auto-delete knowledge entries older than N days.
Default: None (keep forever).

ModelConfig.description:
Configuration for a model.

Models can be loaded from local files (ONNX) or pulled from registries
and served via a runtime backend.

agentic.description: Operator-defined agentic capabilities for model selection.

api_key.description: API key for authenticated model servers.

base_url.description:
Base URL for remote model servers (e.g., OGX, custom OpenAI-compatible).
Overrides the default URL for the chosen runtime.

context_size.description: Context window size for runtime-served models (default: 4096).

device.description:
Execution device for ONNX models: "cpu", "cuda", "openvino",
"openvino:AUTO", "openvino:NPU", "openvino:GPU".
Defaults to "cpu" if not specified.

execution_mode.description:
Execution mode: "in_process" (ONNX in gateway process) or "served"
(spawn inference server). Auto-derived from `task` if not set:
embedding/classification → in_process, chat/generate → served.
Override to serve an embedding model via vLLM or load a small
chat model in-process.

format.description:
Model format: "gguf", "safetensors", "awq", "gptq".
Auto-detected from the model path if not specified.

ifc_clearance.description:
Operator vouch that this model may serve conversations the
safety pipeline flags as sensitive. Local models are cleared
implicitly (data stays on-device); remote entries need
`ifc_clearance = "sensitive"` as a deliberate, per-entry
operator decision (e.g., an in-tenant VPC endpoint under a
data processing agreement).

kv_cache.description:
KV cache with independent key/value types (e.g. `kv_cache = { keys = "q8_0", values = "turbo3" }`).
Takes precedence over `cache_type` when both are set.

locality.description:
Data locality: "local" (default) or "remote".
Remote models require content filtering before sending.

model_name.description: Model name for the OpenAI-compatible API. Defaults to the config key.

model_path.description: Path to a local model file (ONNX). Used directly when no `source` is set.

parallel.description: Number of parallel request slots for runtime (default: 1).

port.description:
Port for the model's HTTP endpoint (default: auto-select).
Set this to a fixed port for predictable URLs.

runtime.description:
Runtime backend: "auto", "podman", "direct", or "none" (default).
Used for chat/generate tasks served via navra-model-runtime.

source.description:
Hub source URI (e.g. `ollama://granite3.3:8b`, `hf://org/repo`).
When set, the model is pulled and cached via navra-model-hub.

tokenizer_path.description: Path to the HuggingFace tokenizer.json file.

ModelIfcConfig.description:
IFC-driven model routing configuration.

When the safety pipeline flags conversation content as sensitive
(PII, secrets), the gateway's `/v1` model proxy forces the request
onto the configured sensitive model so the data only flows where
the operator has vouched it may. This override beats cost routing
and compaction deferral.

deny_without_sensitive_model.description:
Deny the request when sensitive content is detected and no
cleared sensitive model is available (fail-closed). When false
(default), the request proceeds on the uncleared model with a
warning — detection strength is bounded by the caller's
safety pipeline.

sensitive_model.description:
Model (a `[models.*]` key) that serves sensitive
conversations. Must itself be IFC-cleared: local models are
cleared implicitly; remote entries need
`ifc_clearance = "sensitive"` on the model entry.

ModelTierConfig.description: A single tier in the routing configuration.

max_tokens.description: Maximum output tokens for requests routed to this tier.

model.description: Model identifier to use for this tier.

patterns.description: Tool name glob patterns that route to this tier.

memory.description: Persistent memory module with PII-aware retention.

registry.description: MCP server registry and discovery module.

enabled.description: Whether the monitoring agent is enabled. Default: false.

NetworkPolicy.description:
Network egress policy controlling which external endpoints a sandboxed
upstream MCP server can reach.

Both domains and IP addresses are supported. When `deny_all_external`
is true (the default), raw IP addresses are blocked unless they appear
in `allowed_ips`. This prevents bypassing domain-based rules by
resolving to an IP and connecting directly.

allowed_domains.description:
Domains the upstream is allowed to reach (e.g., `"*.googleapis.com"`).
Supports wildcard prefix matching (`*.example.com`).

allowed_ips.description:
IP addresses or CIDR ranges allowed (e.g., `"10.0.0.0/8"`).
Raw IP access is blocked by default when `deny_all_external` is true.

blocked_domains.description: Domains explicitly blocked (deny wins over allow).

deny_all_external.description:
When true, only `allowed_domains` and `allowed_ips` are reachable.
Default: true.

api_key_value.description: API key value (or env var reference).

basic_password.description: Basic auth password (or env var reference).

bearer.description: Bearer token (or env var reference like "${JIRA_TOKEN}").

default_permissions.description: Default permission set when no label matches.

http_timeout_secs.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for JWKS fetches (default: 5).

label_mapping.description:
Maps OpenShell label expressions to navra permission set names.
Example: "role=worker" -> "restricted"

oneOf.description: Verify JWT-SVID against SPIRE trust bundle.

audience.description: Expected audience claim (if set, audience validation is enabled).

trust_bundle_path.description: Path to SPIRE agent trust bundle PEM.

oneOf.description: Verify JWT against OIDC provider JWKS endpoint.

Trust Unix socket peer credentials.
Returns InvalidToken to let the chain continue to other authenticators.
Verify JWT signed by OpenShell gateway's Ed25519 key.

audience.description: Expected audience claim (if set, audience validation is enabled).

public_key_path.description: Path to the gateway's Ed25519 public key PEM.

allow.description: Glob patterns of allowed file paths (e.g., "~/Code/**").

approve.description: Operations requiring human approval before execution.

can_delegate.description: Whether agents with this permission set can delegate capabilities.

cedar_policies.description:
Paths to Cedar policy files for this permission set (e.g. the
bundled `policies/owasp-asi-baseline.cedar`). Files from all
permission sets are combined into one engine; policies can
branch on `context.permission_set`. Requires the `cedar`
feature. Unreadable or unparsable files abort startup (fail
closed).

chain_policy.description:
Actor-chain delegation policy. When set, the gateway enforces
chain depth limits and optionally requires a WIMSE-identified root.

compliance.description:
Compliance framework tags for this permission set.
Informational — logged at startup for audit trail.
Example: ["SOC2-CC6.1", "EU-AI-Act-Art-14", "HIPAA-164.312"]

credentials.description: Credential labels this permission set can access.

default_tool_policy.description: Default policy for tools not matched by any rule: "allow", "deny", "approve"

deny.description: Glob patterns of denied file paths (e.g., "**/.env").

dmn_decision.description: Name of the DMN decision to evaluate (must match a `<decision name="...">` in the DMN file).

dmn_policies.description:
Path to a DMN decision table file for business-rule guardrails.
The decision table is evaluated as an additional policy gate.
Requires the `dmn` feature.

domain_rules.description:
Semantic domain rules: which operations are allowed per domain.
Evaluated before glob-based tool_rules as an additional gate.
If absent, domain-based enforcement is skipped (backward compat).

Example:
```toml
domain_rules = [
  { domain = "filesystem", operations = ["read", "write"] },
  { domain = "shell", operations = [] },
  { domain = "*", operations = ["read"] },
]
```

egress_allowed_domains.description:
Egress filtering: domains allowed for tool calls containing URLs.
When non-empty alongside `egress_deny_all_external`, the
EgressFilterHook blocks tool calls targeting unlisted domains.

egress_blocked_domains.description: Egress filtering: domains explicitly blocked (deny wins over allow).

egress_deny_all_external.description:
When true and egress domains are configured, deny all external
endpoints not in the allowlist.

max_concurrent.description: Maximum concurrent tool calls per agent session.

max_context.description: Context window cap passed to the model for agents in this set.

model.description:
Default model for agents in this permission set (must match a
key in `[models]`). Overridable per-agent.

rate_limit.description: Rate limit: maximum tool calls per window (e.g., "60/60" = 60 calls per 60 seconds).

redaction_threshold.description:
Minimum finding confidence for redaction in this set's safety
pipeline. Findings below the threshold are left in the text and
the result is marked partially redacted — no declassification
(raw PII may remain). Default 0.0: every finding is redacted.

ring.description:
Privilege ring (0 = most privileged, 3 = most restricted).
When set, deny rules and approval requirements cascade from
lower-numbered rings, and operations are intersected.

safety_patterns.description: Custom regex patterns for content safety filtering.

safety_thresholds.description:
Per-category confidence thresholds for multi-label safety models.

Used when `safety = "multi-label"`. Each key is a category name
(e.g., "harm", "jailbreak", "pii") and the value is the minimum
confidence score (0.0-1.0) to trigger filtering for that category.

Example:
```toml
[permissions.dev.safety_thresholds]
harm = 0.7
jailbreak = 0.9
pii = 0.5
refusal = 0.8
```

tainted_write_policy.description:
IFC policy for tainted writes: "allow", "approve", or "deny".
When an agent reads external data (taint rises to Untrusted),
this policy controls whether subsequent writes are permitted.

tool_class.description:
Override auto-classification for specific tools.
Keys are tool names, values specify domain and operation.

Example:
```toml
[permissions.readonly.tool_class]
zip_files = { domain = "filesystem", operation = "write" }
```

tool_disclosure_exclude.description: Tool disclosure: glob patterns of tools to hide from tools/list.

tool_disclosure_include.description:
Tool disclosure: glob patterns of tools to show in tools/list.
Empty = show all tools. This is UI-level filtering only — agents
can still call hidden tools if they know the name.

tool_rules.description: Per-tool permission rules (evaluated before handler invocation).

trusted_paths.description:
File paths that should keep their Trusted integrity label even
when accessed via external read tools. Supports glob patterns.
Example: ["~/Code/myproject/**", "~/Documents/**"]

upstream.description:
Upstream MCP servers visible to agents in this set (by name).
Empty = all upstreams visible (backward compat). Overridable per-agent.

PiiPatternConfig.description:
A custom PII pattern for global content safety filtering.

Categories defined here are treated as PII for IFC labeling,
unlike `SafetyPatternConfig` which only triggers redaction/blocking.

db.description: Database path. Defaults to the same directory as docs, separate file.

enabled.description: Enable the RAG module. Default: true.

query_cache_max_entries.description: Maximum number of cached query entries (default: 1000).

query_cache_ttl_secs.description: Query cache TTL in seconds (default: 300). Set to 0 to disable caching.

reranker_model_path.description: Path to the ONNX cross-encoder model for reranking (optional).

reranker_tokenizer_path.description: Path to the tokenizer.json for the cross-encoder model (optional).

RegistryEntry.description: A whitelisted MCP server for the registry.

registry_type.description:
Registry type: "mcp", "http", "aws_agent_registry".
- "mcp": queries an MCP registry endpoint (default)
- "http": generic HTTP/JSON registry with configurable URL template
- "aws_agent_registry": AWS Agent Registry (future)

results_path.description:
JSON path to extract results from the HTTP response (default: root array).
Example: "data.results" to extract from `{"data": {"results": [...]}}`

search_url.description:
URL template for search queries (HTTP type only).
Use `{query}` as placeholder for the search term.
Example: "https://registry.example.com/api/search?q={query}"

cache_ttl_secs.description: Cache TTL for registry responses in seconds (default: 3600 = 1 hour).

enabled.description: Enable the registry module. Default: true.

RoutingConfig.description: Configuration for the routing hook, deserializable from TOML.

default_tier.description: Default tier when no rule matches.

tiers.description: Model tiers, ordered from smallest to largest.

enabled.description:
Master switch. Routing is inert without rules, so this only
provides an explicit kill switch.

min_messages.description:
Minimum conversation length (in messages) before downgrading.
Early turns rarely reveal task difficulty, so the first
exchanges always run on the requested model.

rules.description: Routing rules, matched by the requested model name.

RoutingRule.description: A single routing rule: requests for `from` may be served by `to`.

from.description: The frontier (expensive) model, as named by the client.

switch_only_at_compaction.description:
Only switch models at compaction boundaries (recommended when
`to` is a remote provider with server-side prompt caching).

to.description: The cheap model to downgrade to.

SafetyPatternConfig.description: A custom regex pattern for safety filtering.

agent_signature_policy.description:
Agent bundle signature policy: "enforce", "warn", or "skip".
Controls whether `navra agent install` requires cosign signature
verification. Default: "warn".

allow_direct_execution.description:
Allow direct (unsandboxed) execution when no container runtime
is available. Default: `false`.

cedar_action_version.description:
Cedar action dispatch version. 1 (default) dispatches bare
tool names as Cedar actions (compatibility). 2 namespaces
upstream tool calls under the modeled
`Action::"upstream_tool_call"` (tool name in the context), so
the bundled ASI01/ASI10 policies apply to upstream calls as a
class. See the security docs for the migration note.

config_watch.description: Watch the config file for changes and hot-reload.

config_watch_debounce_ms.description: Debounce interval in ms for config file watch events.

containerized.description:
Use containerized agent execution.
`true` = always, `false` = never, absent = auto-detect Podman.

discovery.description:
AID discovery configuration. When set, navra serves
`/.well-known/agent` for the AID fallback protocol.

hide_denied_tools.description:
Hide tools with a static `Deny` in `tool_rules` from
`tools/list`. Default: `true` (deny-wins philosophy — a denied
tool's description is injection surface for a tool the agent
cannot call). Set `false` to restore listing denied tools.

identity.description: Root identity configuration for DID-based auth.

kubernetes_context.description: kubectl context override for agent sandboxes.

kubernetes_gateway_service.description: Kubernetes Service name for the navra gateway (in-cluster DNS).

kubernetes_namespace.description:
Kubernetes namespace for agent sandboxes.
When set, enables spawning agents as Sandbox CRs on the cluster.

mcp_version.description:
MCP protocol version: "2026-07-28" (stateless dispatch, default)
or "2025-03-26" (legacy session-based, deprecated).

model_server_image.description: Container image for the shared model server.

openshell_auth.description:
OpenShell identity federation config.
When set, OpenShellAuthenticator is inserted into the auth chain.

openshell_gateway.description: OpenShell compute driver gRPC endpoint for agent sandboxing.

pii_model_path.description:
Path to PII NER model directory (English).
Default: ~/.local/share/navra/models/pii-ner/

pii_multilingual_model_path.description:
Path to multilingual PII NER model directory.
Default: ~/.local/share/navra/models/pii-ner-multilingual/

session_ttl_secs.description:
Session idle TTL in seconds (default: 3600). Stale sessions are
expired on each new connection to prevent accumulation.

tcp.description: TCP listen address (e.g., "127.0.0.1:9315"). Used instead of socket when set.

wimse_auth.description:
WIMSE/SPIFFE identity federation config.
When set, WimseAuthenticator is inserted into the auth chain.

ws_idle_timeout_secs.description:
WebSocket idle timeout in seconds (default: 600 = 10 minutes).
Connections with no activity are closed after this duration.

ws_ping_interval_secs.description:
WebSocket ping interval in seconds (default: 30).
Server sends ping frames at this interval; closes after 3 missed pongs.

SpeculativeModelConfig.description: Speculative decoding configuration for runtime-served models.

draft_min_p.description: Minimum probability threshold for draft acceptance (default: 0.0).

draft_model.description: Model name or path for the draft (fast) model.

draft_tokens.description: Number of tokens to draft per step (default: 5).

StatisticalGuardrailServerConfig.description:
Server-side configuration for the statistical guardrail hook.

```toml
[statistical]
enabled = true
cosine_window = 50
cosine_z_threshold = 3.0
entropy_window = 20
entropy_min = 0.5
entropy_max = 4.0
block_on_anomaly = false
```

block_on_anomaly.description:
Whether to block tool calls when anomalies are detected.
Default: false (monitor/warn only).

cosine_window.description: Sliding window size for cosine drift detection. Default: 50.

cosine_z_threshold.description: Z-score threshold for cosine drift anomaly detection. Default: 3.0.

enabled.description: Whether statistical guardrails are enabled. Default: false.

entropy_window.description: Sliding window size for entropy monitoring. Default: 20.

transition_min_observations.description: Minimum observations before transition anomalies are flagged (default: 10).

transition_window.description: Sliding window size for tool-transition anomaly detection (default: 50).

TemporalContractConfig.description: A single temporal contract definition in server config.

applies_to.description: Permission sets this contract applies to (glob patterns, "*" = all).

name.description: Unique contract name for logging and diagnostics.

TemporalContractServerConfig.description:
Server-side configuration for temporal behavioral contracts.

```toml
[temporal_contracts]
enabled = true
max_history_per_session = 200

[[temporal_contracts.contracts]]
name = "read-before-write"
description = "Must read a file before writing"
predicate = { type = "requires", tool = "file_write", prerequisite = "file_read" }
action = { type = "block", value = "Read the file first" }
applies_to = ["*"]
```

enabled.description: Whether temporal contracts are enabled. Default: false.

max_history_per_session.description: Maximum action history entries per session. Default: 200.

ToolClassConfig.description: Classification override for a specific tool.

domain.description: Domain to assign (must be a valid navra Domain).

operation.description: Operation to assign (must be a valid navra Operation).

ToolRuleConfig.description: A per-tool permission rule in config.

TriggerConfig.description: Configuration for a single trigger, deserialized from TOML.

flow_name.description: Name of the flow to start when triggered

path.description: URL path suffix, e.g. "/hook/deploy" becomes POST /hook/deploy

secret.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret for request verification

flow_name.description: Name of the flow to start on schedule

schedule.description: Cron expression: "minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week"

flow_name.description: Name of the flow to start when a matching file changes

pattern.description: Optional glob pattern to filter events, e.g. "*.pdf"

TrustedProvider.description: A provider whose agent JWTs are trusted by this gateway.

default_permissions.description: Permission set assigned to agents from this provider.

jwks_uri.description:
JWKS endpoint for key fetching (not used yet — keys are
pre-registered or fetched externally).

UpstreamBoundsConfig.description:
Content bounds for upstream discovery responses.

Upstream `tools/list` responses are untrusted input. Without
bounds, a hostile server can flood the gateway with tool
definitions or absurdly nested schemas. Exceeding a bound rejects
the upstream registration with a clear error (fail closed) unless
`truncate_oversized = true`, in which case descriptions are
truncated and excess tools dropped with warnings. Schema depth can
never be truncated and always rejects.

```toml
[upstream.bounds]
max_tools = 500
max_description_length = 2048
truncate_oversized = false
```

max_description_length.description: Maximum length (bytes) of any tool description. Default: 4096.

max_input_schema_depth.description:
Maximum JSON nesting depth of any tool's input schema.
Default: 32.

max_tools.description:
Maximum number of tools accepted from one upstream.
Default: 1000.

max_total_definition_bytes.description:
Maximum total size (bytes) of all serialized tool definitions.
Default: 4194304 (4 MiB).

truncate_oversized.description:
Truncate instead of reject where truncation is sound
(descriptions, tool count). Default: `false` (fail closed).

auth.description: Authentication for the target API (used with openapi upstreams).

bounds.description:
Content bounds for this upstream's discovery response. Defaults
are applied per field; see [`UpstreamBoundsConfig`].

credentials.description:
Credential label mappings: env var name → credential store label.
The credential is resolved from the OS keyring at launch time
and injected as an environment variable into the server process.
Credentials are zeroized in navra's memory after injection.

enabled.description: Enable or disable this upstream. Default: true (absent = enabled).

env.description:
Environment variables to set when launching this upstream.
Values support credential store references: `"${credential:label}"`
resolves the label via the navra credential store (OS keyring or env).
Plain values are passed through as-is.

manifest.description:
Signed tool manifest for this upstream. When set, the upstream
is only registered if the manifest signature verifies under
TOFU pinning and the served tools match the signed set exactly.
A key change after pinning rejects the upstream (no re-pin).

max_response_bytes.description:
Maximum response body size in bytes for OpenAPI upstreams.
Responses exceeding this limit are truncated to avoid overwhelming
LLM context windows. Default: 32768 (32 KB).

name.description: Unique name for this upstream server.

network.description:
Network egress policy for sandboxed execution.
When absent and `--sandbox` is used, defaults to deny-all.

oauth.description:
OAuth 2.1 configuration for authenticating to this upstream server.
When set, navra acts as an OAuth client and handles token acquisition,
refresh, and 401/403 challenges automatically.

openapi.description:
OpenAPI 3.x spec source (URL or file path).
When set, transport/command/url are ignored — navra parses the spec
and exposes operations as MCP tools directly.

refresh_debounce_ms.description:
Minimum interval between `tools/list_changed` refreshes for
this upstream, in milliseconds (debounce against a chatty
upstream). Default: 1000.

scan_tools.description:
Scan tool definitions advertised by this upstream for
supply-chain threats (tool poisoning, typosquatting, schema
abuse, hidden unicode, rug pulls, ...). Tools classified
Malicious are dropped; Suspicious tools are registered with a
warning. Default: `true`. Disabling is discouraged — it removes
the only gate between upstream tool descriptions and agent
context.

tool_class.description:
Per-tool semantic classification overrides.
Keys are tool names, values specify domain and operation.
Takes precedence over auto-classification and tool_overrides.

Example:
```toml
[upstream.tool_class]
zip_files = { domain = "filesystem", operation = "write" }
```

tool_filter.description:
Tool name filter — only expose operations matching these names.
Matches against both the prefixed tool name and the raw operationId.
Supports glob patterns (e.g., "get_*", "*_search").

tool_hash_path.description:
Override the rug-pull hash store location for this upstream.
Default: `~/.local/share/navra/tool_hashes.json`. Set per
upstream to isolate hash stores between navra instances.

tool_overrides.description:
Per-tool operation overrides: "read", "write", or "deny".
Overrides the auto-classification from MCP annotations and
name heuristics. Tools set to "deny" are never registered.

UpstreamOAuthConfig.description:
OAuth 2.1 client configuration for upstream MCP servers.

Enables navra to authenticate to remote upstream servers that require
OAuth. Supports Authorization Code + PKCE, Client Credentials, and
Device Authorization (RFC 8628) flows.

client_id.description:
Pre-registered OAuth client ID. If absent, navra uses Dynamic
Client Registration (RFC 7591) to obtain credentials.

client_secret.description:
Pre-registered client secret (or env var reference like "${SECRET}").
Required for Client Credentials flow.

flow.description:
OAuth flow preference: "auto" (default), "code", "client_credentials", "device".

- "auto": tries client_credentials if secret is present, then device
  auth if headless (no DISPLAY/WAYLAND), else authorization code + PKCE.
- "code": Authorization Code + PKCE with localhost callback.
- "client_credentials": Machine-to-machine, no user interaction.
- "device": Device Authorization Flow (RFC 8628).

enabled.description: Enable the vision module. Default: true.

model.description: Name of the vision model in [models.*] config.

asr_model.description: Name of the ASR model in [models.*] config.

enabled.description: Enable the voice module. Default: true.

silence_timeout_ms.description: Silence timeout in milliseconds before auto-stopping recording (default: 1500).

tts_model.description: Name of the TTS model in [models.*] config.

accept_spiffe_svid.description: Also accept raw SPIFFE JWT-SVIDs (without WIMSE extensions).

WimseProviderConfig.description: Configuration for a trusted WIMSE/SPIFFE identity provider.

default_permissions.description: Permission set assigned to agents from this provider.
